Dhruva Space raises Rs 147 crore in pre-Series B round
stories.summary: Dhruva Space is raising Rs 147 crore in a pre-Series B round led by IndusBridge Ventures. The company recently issued preference shares at Rs 9,34,429.47 apiece. This follows a Rs 60 crore investment from Antariksh Venture Capital Fund in July 2026. Space remains an expensive hobby.

stories.title: MistEO secures Rs 18 crore for climate forecasting
stories.summary: Climate intelligence startup MistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in seed funding led by MGF-Kavachh. The Kerala-based company plans to use the capital to scale its Climate Decision Intelligence platform and expand into new Asian markets. It aims to provide risk insights to banks and insurers.

DLI-backed C2i Semiconductors raises $15 million from Peak XV, marking largest funding round for Indian chip startup - D
Morsa raises $1.5 million to automate manufacturing
stories.summary: Morsa has raised $1.5 million to build what it describes as an autonomous AI Chief Operating Officer for manufacturing plants. The startup plans to use the funds to strengthen product development and expand deployments in India and the United States. It is currently automating shop-floor execution.

stories.title: QB MEN raises pre-seed funding for menswear brand
stories.summary: Jaipur-based menswear brand QB MEN has raised an undisclosed amount in a pre-seed round led by BeyondSeed. The startup plans to focus on storytelling, content creation, and community engagement to reach its target of 100 percent year-on-year growth. The investment is earmarked for brand-building rather than inventory.

stories.title: MistEO raises Rs 18 crore in seed funding
stories.summary: Climate intelligence startup MistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed round led by MGF-Kavachh. The company provides weather risk insights to banks, insurers, and agricultural value chains. It plans to use the funds to improve its forecasting models and expand its presence in Asian markets.

stories.title: Kutlerri.ai raises $4 million for restaurant AI
stories.summary: Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million from Narahari Investments to scale its AI-powered catering sales agents. The startup plans to launch three additional AI agents and a mobile-first application for restaurant operators. It uses a performance-linked pricing model to help restaurants increase profitability.

stories.title: Astrome secures Rs 64 crore for satellite network
stories.summary: Astrome Technologies has secured Rs 64.05 crore from the Technology Development Board to develop an AI-powered electronic intelligence satellite constellation. The project carries an estimated total investment of Rs 128.11 crore. The funding is structured as optionally convertible debt to support domestic strategic space technologies.

stories.title: Inbound Aerospace raises $1 million
stories.summary: Inbound Aerospace has raised $1 million from Speciale Invest to develop autonomous, reusable re-entry vehicles. The startup, incubated at IIT Madras, aims to deliver experiments between Earth and space. It plans to use the capital to advance research and achieve design milestones for its spacecraft systems.

stories.title: IvyCap Ventures leads $13 million round for Live2.ai
stories.summary: IvyCap Ventures led a $13 million pre-Series B funding round for Woovly India, which operates under the brand Live2.ai. The company develops AI products designed to assist with expansion across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific. The round included participation from an additional institutional investor.

stories.title: Daylight raises $80 million in Series B
stories.summary: Cybersecurity company Daylight has raised $80 million in a Series B round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives. The company combines AI agents with human security experts to automate threat detection. Daylight reports that its revenue has grown more than 40-fold since its inception.

stories.title: Cyberstarts raises $360 million across two funds
stories.summary: Cyberstarts has raised $360 million across two new investment vehicles. A dedicated $300 million fund will support Cyera, which is reportedly raising $800 million at a $20 billion valuation. The firm continues to specialize in early-stage investments within the cybersecurity sector.

stories.title: Edelbyte raises $70 million to challenge data giants
stories.summary: Edelbyte has emerged from stealth with $70 million to compete with data infrastructure providers like Snowflake and Databricks. Founded by four Microsoft veterans, the company is building a search and analytics platform to handle AI-driven workloads without increasing costs. It is entering a crowded market.

stories.title: Exclusive | Goldman Leads Investment in Cybersecurity Startup at $400 Million Valuation - WSJ
LangChain raises $300 million at $3 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI agent management startup LangChain has raised $300 million in a Series C round led by CapitalG. The company's valuation has doubled to $3 billion in one year. Its software currently serves 7,000 customers, including Nvidia, Toyota, and Salesforce. Growth is evidently still in fashion.

stories.title: Lumbra raises $25 million for AI agents
stories.summary: Lumbra has raised $25 million in a Series A round led by Point72 Ventures and Ansa. The startup builds software for AI agents intended for sensitive government networks and plans to expand the technology into banks and hospitals. It aims to bridge classified work with commercial demand.

stories.title: Ballistic Ventures seeks $490 million for cybersecurity funds
stories.summary: Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $490 million across two new funds, citing artificial intelligence as a driver for security demand. Regulatory filings show the firm is targeting $360 million for its third flagship fund and $130 million for a separate vehicle. Neither fund has recorded sales yet.

stories.title: Ex-Anthropic researchers' startup Mirendil raises $1 billion to let AI agents do the work of an AI lab - MLQ.ai
Rox raises $100 million at $1.3 billion valuation
stories.summary: AI startup Rox has raised $100 million in Series B funding, reaching a $1.3 billion valuation. The round included participation from Prosperity7 Ventures, the venture arm of Saudi Aramco. The company develops autonomous agents designed to automate sales workflows and identify commercial opportunities for large enterprise clients.

Fractile raises $720 million to design AI hardware
stories.summary: British startup Fractile has raised $720 million in a Series C round to design AI chips aimed at reducing production costs. The government, which backed the round, values the company at over 5 billion pounds. Fractile describes itself as a frontier AI company with a full-stack approach.

stories.title: Oister Global launches deeptech fund
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Oister Global has launched a growth-stage deeptech fund targeting Rs 400 crore, with an option to raise an additional Rs 200 crore. The fund will target 8-10 companies across sectors including space, defence and semiconductors. It requires companies to have paying customers and proprietary intellectual property.

stories.title: Indian startup funding hits 2026 low
stories.summary: Venture capital funding into Indian startups dropped to $26 million across 11 deals during the second week of November. This marks the lowest weekly level for 2026, following a previous week that saw $263 million in investment. The decline is attributed to festive periods and reduced deal activity.

stories.title: Irish venture funding drops to 10-year low
stories.summary: Irish technology venture funding reached €113.8 million in the third quarter of 2026, according to the Irish Venture Capital & Private Equity Association. This represents a 45 percent decline compared to the same period last year and marks the lowest third-quarter total in a decade.

stories.title: Fusion launches defense tech investment program
stories.summary: Israeli venture capital firm Fusion is launching a defense technology program offering up to $2 million in initial funding. The initiative aims to provide startups with access to industry networks in Israel, the United States and Europe, targeting early-stage companies that have received less attention than drone sectors.

stories.title: How Neil Mehta’s biggest bet is shaping Greenoaks’ India growth story
stories.summary: It was in June 2019, Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses, a B2B manufacturing capacity aggregating platform, was barely a year old when a team from a venture capital firm in the US landed in Bengaluru on about a day’s notice. They did not stay in a conference room but drove down to

stories.title: Egypt plans dedicated fund for startups
stories.summary: The Ministry of Planning and Economic Development intends to launch a financing initiative to support startups across various growth stages. The fund aims to address financing gaps as companies transition from product development to commercial expansion, while seeking to attract more international venture capital into the Egyptian ecosystem.

stories.title: Anup Gupta to leave Nexus Venture Partners
stories.summary: Anup Gupta, a partner at Nexus Venture Partners, is set to depart the firm in June 2026 after nearly 17 years. His exit follows a series of senior-level departures at major Indian venture capital firms. Nexus recently raised its eighth fund, which Gupta helped manage.

stories.title: The Consumer Capital 100: India’s Most Influential D2C Investors - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Introduction India’s Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) ecosystem has evolved into one of the country’s most dynamic startup segments, creating a new generation of consumer brands across beauty, fashion, food, wellness, lifestyle, and other categories. Behind this transformation is a growing network of investors who provide more than just capital, bringing strategic guidance,

stories.summary: Introduction India’s private capital ecosystem is undergoing a remarkable transformation, driven by visionary investors who are shaping the flow of capital, innovation and entrepreneurship across the country. From venture capital firms backing high-growth startups to family offices taking a long-term approach to wealth creation, these leaders are playing an increasingly

stories.title: India startup base grows as funding becomes selective
stories.summary: India's recognized startup base exceeded 250,000 in October 2026. While domestic fundraising doubled in 2025, seed funding fell 37 percent in the first nine months of 2026. A new report suggests emerging managers should prioritize research-led theses and disciplined reserves to improve exit outcomes for their investors.

stories.title: Secondary market expands in Indian venture capital
stories.summary: The private secondary market is deepening in India, providing a new way for venture investors to recoup capital beyond IPOs. While India has historically seen limited M&A activity, the secondary market is now viewed as a necessary component for fund returns and the ability to back future founders.

stories.title: Watrana Rentals sets IPO dates
stories.summary: Logistics firm Watrana Rentals has scheduled its initial public offering for November 19 to November 23, 2026. The company rents material handling equipment, including forklifts and electric stackers, to industries ranging from automotive to logistics. It also trades in new and used equipment and batteries.

stories.title: EaseMyTrip loss narrows 98 percent
stories.summary: Online travel aggregator EaseMyTrip reported a consolidated net loss of ₹56.5 Lakh for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27, down from ₹36 Cr in the year-ago period. Operating revenue rose 33.5 percent to ₹157.9 Cr. The company is currently trimming its losses.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files for ₹9,500 crore IPO
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed a Red Herring Prospectus for an initial public offering estimated to raise ₹9,500 crore. The parent company, Coal India, plans to sell a 10 percent stake in the subsidiary. The offering remains subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals.

stories.title: DroneAcharya profits fall 65 percent
stories.summary: DroneAcharya reported a 65.3 percent decline in net profit to ₹67 Lakh for the first half of fiscal year 2026-27. Operating revenue fell 18.3 percent to ₹7.8 Cr compared to the same period last year. The company previously reported a net loss in the second half of 2026.

FirstCry revenue grows 14 percent
stories.summary: Brainbees Solutions, parent company of FirstCry, reported a 14 percent year-on-year increase in operating revenue to ₹2,396 crore for the September quarter. The company narrowed its net loss by 75 percent to ₹12.6 crore. It is moving closer to profitability.

stories.title: FirstCry Q2 loss narrows to ₹12.6 crore
stories.summary: FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions narrowed its net loss by 75.1 percent to ₹12.6 Cr in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27. Operating revenue reached ₹2,395.8 Cr, a 14.1 percent increase from the year-ago quarter. The company continues to inch toward profitability.

stories.title: Razorpay receives Sebi approval for IPO
stories.summary: Fintech firm Razorpay has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India to proceed with an initial public offering. The company expects to raise between ₹5,000 crore and ₹6,000 crore, with a potential listing scheduled for the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Razorpay gets Sebi nod for ₹6,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has issued observations on Razorpay's draft IPO papers, allowing the fintech company to proceed with its public issue. The offering is expected to raise up to ₹6,000 crore and value the company at approximately $5 billion.

stories.title: Razorpay secures Sebi clearance for IPO
stories.summary: Razorpay has received regulatory approval for an initial public offering expected to raise up to ₹6,000 crore. The company is targeting a valuation of $5 billion, which would be lower than the $7.5 billion valuation commanded during its 2021 private funding round.

stories.title: Crystal Crop Protection sets IPO price band
stories.summary: Crystal Crop Protection has fixed its IPO price band at ₹259 to ₹272 per share. The offering, which opens November 18, 2026, comprises a fresh issue of ₹355 crore and an offer for sale of 3.7 million shares. The company operates in the agricultural inputs sector.

stories.title: Razorpay receives regulatory approval for IPO
stories.summary: Indian fintech firm Razorpay has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India for its initial public offering. The company previously filed papers confidentially to protect sensitive information. It is backed by investors including Y Combinator and Singapore's sovereign wealth fund.

stories.title: Ajinkya Rahane invests in cookware startup Ember
stories.summary: Former cricketer Ajinkya Rahane has invested an undisclosed amount in Bengaluru-based cookware startup Ember. The company plans to use the funds to expand its product portfolio and distribution network. Financial terms and the specific stake acquired by Rahane were not disclosed.

stories.title: Starling founder plots AI-powered bank
stories.summary: Anne Boden, founder of Starling Bank, is building a new digital bank designed to allow AI agents to make payments on behalf of customers. This marks her return to the fintech sector three years after stepping down as CEO of the British neobank.

stories.title: Noel Tata on the Tata philosophy
stories.summary: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata stated that philanthropy must take precedence over profits within the conglomerate. He described the group's business model as one where profits from companies are intended to support social welfare initiatives, noting that charity owns commerce.

stories.title: Mercor founders reach billionaire status
stories.summary: Mercor co-founders Adarsh Hiremath and Surya Midha are estimated to be worth ₹40,000 crore each following a $750 million funding round that valued the AI startup at $20 billion. The three co-founders are 23 years old and hold 21 percent stakes in the company.

stories.title: Raj Shamani becomes top YouTube podcaster
stories.summary: Raj Shamani's podcast Figuring Out has reached 22 million subscribers, surpassing The Diary of a CEO and The Joe Rogan Experience. Launched in 2021, the show focuses on entrepreneurship and personal development and is now the most-subscribed podcast on the platform globally.

Oracle executive advises focusing on results over agent count
stories.summary: Oracle senior vice president Natalia Rachelson says businesses should judge AI success by measurable improvements rather than the number of agents deployed. She suggests leaders establish a baseline to track outcomes like reduced accounting errors or lower transport costs. The technology is moving from helping to doing work.

stories.title: Reports detail Jensen Huang's conduct toward senior executive
stories.summary: A report details an incident where former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told executive vice president Jay Puri he hoped he would die during a meeting with 30 employees in February 2025. The exchange occurred shortly before Huang's departure from the company. The company has not commented on the report.

stories.title: Ola Electric shifts to dealer model as registrations decline
stories.summary: Ola Electric is closing company-owned outlets to transition to independent dealers. Founder Bhavish Aggarwal insists demand is not a constraint, despite registration figures showing a 19.5 percent decline compared to the previous year. The company registered 41,653 vehicles during the July to September quarter of fiscal year 2027.

stories.title: Report claims Jensen Huang concealed relationship from executives
stories.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly concealed an affair with businesswoman Alice Huang from senior company executives. According to Reuters, Huang described his interactions as appropriate business dealings when questioned about the relationship last year and again in October 2026. The company has not provided a statement.

stories.title: Nvidia's influence on Indian AI ecosystem remains under scrutiny
stories.summary: Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia has raised questions about the future of the company's extensive footprint in India. Nvidia currently supports the local AI industry through hardware, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, and equity investments. The company remains deeply embedded across nearly every layer of India's AI sector.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO outlines hiring criteria ahead of IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei says the company rejects technically talented candidates who do not fit its culture. Amodei stated he avoids hiring people who are jerks or those who attempt to steal the show. The company's workforce grew from 940 employees in 2024 to 5,300 by September.

research.title: AI discovers a hidden heart signal that could predict sudden death
research.summary: Scientists have uncovered a hidden warning sign in routine heart scans that could predict sudden cardiac death before it strikes. The AI-powered discovery outperformed conventional screening methods, potentially revealing thousands of people at risk of a fatal heart malfunction that doctors might otherwise miss.
